params.body:
## Why

The "Leads" list on the worklists page was a six-column table (vehicle, name, phone, e-mail, date, icons) inside a 360 px scroll box. At tablet width the columns wrapped, the message (the one thing the seller wants to read) sat behind the eye button and, once open, was the smallest text on the card. Owner, 2026-09-16: "krakkemikkig hoe klein leads op de pagina staat, zeker om te lezen".

## What changed

`resources/views/worklist/widgets/4.blade.php`, rewritten as a list of cards, one per lead, no `<table>`, styled with Tailwind classes in the blade (no change to `refresh.css`):

- Head: customer name (semibold, blue dot while unread), the vehicle as a link to its sheet, date/time right-aligned in muted text.
- The question in body size (15 px), line breaks kept (`whitespace-pre-line`), clamped at four lines with a "meer" / "minder" toggle that only appears when there is more. The measurement runs in `x-effect` following the card's fold state, because on a phone the list starts folded (display none) and `x-init` would measure 0. The message is now escaped; it was echoed raw (`{!! !!}`).
- Contact line: phone as `tel:` link, e-mail as `mailto:` link, each with a small icon; the contact preference the customer ticked as a `ui-chip`.
- Actions right: the same three (eye, mark read/unread, delete) as `ui-action-button` icon buttons with `data-tip` (the app's tooltip) and `aria-label`; the two "Bekijk op de website" / "Bekijk op Stocklist Dealer" links as small text links with an icon, 44 px high on a phone. Every route and onclick is unchanged; `#widget_fold_4`, `#lead-{id}`, `.read`/`.unread` and `.ui-lead-links` stay for the scripts and the pagination AJAX. The eye marks an unread lead as read without a reload (the message is already in view, so there is nothing left to unfold).
- No inner scroll (`ui-scroll` removed from this widget only): the list grows with the page. The user-configurable width (`$widget->width`) is untouched.
- Four new keys `lead_show_more` / `lead_show_less` in `resources/lang/{nl,fr,en,de}/worklist.php`.

Not changed: `mails/open_worklist_items.blade.php` does not include this partial. The `.ui-leads-table` column rules in `refresh.css` are now dead; that file is shared by several PRs today, so they are left with a note in the blade and go when the file is next touched.

## Finding

`docs/bedrijfsregels/bevindingen/2026-09-16-lead-contactvoorkeur-labels-gewisseld.md`: `contact_by_phone` reads "via e-mail" and `contact_by_email` reads "via telefoon" in all four language files, and the website form hangs those labels on `by_phone` / `by_email`. The card keeps showing the label the customer saw (same key on the same field as before), so it carries no channel icon; API and proposal leads read the opposite channel until Ilse decides which side to fix.

Rules P1-3.10 and P1-3.12 in `31-p1-dagelijks-werk.md` now describe the card and the text links.

## Screenshots (local, demo dataset, three leads: long, short, phone only)

- 1440 px: three cards under the "Leads (3)" head, the long message clamped at four lines with "meer", phone / e-mail / chip on one line with the three icon buttons at the right, the two view links under it, Transport unchanged below. Nothing scrolls inside the card.
- 390 px: the card stacks (name, vehicle, date on its own line, message, contact line wrapped, actions, the two links each on a line). No horizontal scroll; "meer" appears after the list is unfolded.

## Tests

`WorklistPageTest` (rewrote the lead assertions: `test_a_lead_is_a_readable_card_with_the_question_first`, `test_the_links_under_a_lead_are_two_text_links_with_an_icon`), `LanguageParityTest`, `StylesheetSyntaxTest`, `CompiledViewsTest`, `AlpineExpressionTest`, `HandlerWiringTest`, `RulesCoverageTest`, `RulesIdentityTest`, `SmokeTest` (worklists pages): 27 tests, 845 assertions, one failure that is not this change: `test_the_dialog_lists_every_worklist_as_one_row_with_a_named_switch` fails on my local database because the schema file seeds `widgets` with names such as "Own stock", which the test's `for="[a-z_]+"` cannot match; on an empty `widgets` table (CI) the test inserts its own rows.
params.title: Worklists: the leads widget reads as cards, the question first
